question: What is this platform about?
answer: Our platform is an online learning website where you can enroll in courses on programming, design, and business skills.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click the Sign Up button on the top right corner, enter your email and password, and verify your email to create an account.

question: How can I reset my password?
answer: Go to the login page, click on Forgot Password, and follow the instructions sent to your registered email.

question: Is there a free trial available?
answer: Yes, we offer a 7 day free trial for all new users on any course.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, UPI, net banking, and PayPal.

question: How do I enroll in a course?
answer: Open the course page and click the Enroll Now button. You can pay online or use available offers.

question: Can I get a refund?
answer: Yes, refunds are available within 7 days of purchase if you have completed less than 20 percent of the course.

question: Do I get a certificate after completing a course?
answer: Yes, you receive a verified certificate of completion once you finish all modules and pass the final quiz.

question: How long do I have access to a course?
answer: Once enrolled, you get lifetime access to the course content including future updates.

question: Can I download videos for offline viewing?
answer: Yes, our mobile app allows you to download videos and watch them offline.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can email support@example.com or use the live chat option available on the website.

question: Is there a mobile app?
answer: Yes, our platform is available on both Android and iOS app stores.

question: Can I switch between courses?
answer: Yes, you can switch to another course of equal or lesser value within 30 days of purchase.

question: Do you offer group discounts?
answer: Yes, we offer special pricing for teams and educational institutions. Contact sales for details.

question: How do I update my profile information?
answer: Go to Account Settings from your dashboard to update your name, email, or profile picture.

question: What if I face technical issues during a course?
answer: Please report technical issues through the Help Center or email our support team with details of the problem.

question: Are the courses beginner friendly?
answer: Yes, most of our courses are designed for beginners and include step by step explanations.

question: How can I track my progress?
answer: Your dashboard shows a progress bar for each enrolled course along with completed and pending modules.

question: Can I access courses on multiple devices?
answer: Yes, you can log in and access your courses from any device using the same account.

question: Do you provide job assistance?
answer: Yes, select premium courses include resume reviews, interview preparation, and job referral support.
